name: Evan Bacic
nationality_note: Canadian, from British Columbia. IMDb's bio says he started as a background extra on Riverdale before moving into verticals. Worth noting because origin=english is assumed for this batch and he is the first non-US actor in it.
no_aka: No Alternative name field and no per-credit '(as ...)' billing.
NOTABLE: 39 credits, 38 of them vertical, against 4 on file - the highest vertical share of anyone in the batch. Only one short is excluded.
LAYOUT_TRAP: Eleventh page hit, but harmless: 'Previous 39' is wedged inside the sidebar words 'Personal details', exactly as on Seth Edeen's page. No credit row is affected.
CROSS_REFERENCE: He plays Caleb in 'My Heart Dies from Home'; Kirby Ellwood, from another PDF in this batch, plays Greta White / Clara Walker in the same title.
non_vertical_excluded_note: Excluded as non-vertical: the short You Forever (2024).
